project.name: institutional-quant-research-platform
project.status: Research methodology frozen after Milestone 3D; Milestones 4A through 4D productization complete. External account connection is user-controlled and pending.

notes: Extreme-return and zero-volume rows are review flags, not automatic data errors.
Macro values are carried backward-only from the last available observation; future filling is never used.
Static-universe survivorship bias remains a known Milestone 1 limitation.
Feature warm-up missingness is expected for long lookback features such as 12-1 momentum.

_metadata.purge_rule: A row is retained only when its forward-label end date stays inside its own partition.

4A.scope: Read-only FastAPI research API and deterministic artifact-to-web JSON export layer

4B.scope: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, and Recharts institutional dashboard

4C.scope: Docker Compose orchestration for the dashboard and supplemental FastAPI service

4D.scope: Public repository safeguards, GitHub Actions CI, Vercel dashboard configuration, Render API Blueprint, and production smoke checks

deployment.dashboard: Vercel project with root directory web
deployment.supplemental_api: Render Docker web service from render.yaml
deployment.ci: GitHub Actions on push, pull request, and manual dispatch
deployment.smoke_test: Manually dispatched workflow with production dashboard and API URLs

2A.research_question: Can a regularised linear model improve cross-sectional equity return ranking and test-period portfolio performance relative to hardened baselines?

methodology.target: centered cross-sectional rank of 21-trading-day forward return
methodology.validation: expanding monthly walk-forward; alpha chosen by mean Rank IC
methodology.test: untouched until alpha selection, then expanding monthly walk-forward
methodology.label_availability_rule: training label_end_date must be strictly before signal date
methodology.portfolio: equal-weight long-only top prediction quintile with drift-aware costs

2B.selection_policy: Feature group and Ridge alpha selected only by validation mean Rank IC; portfolio variant selected only by validation Sharpe with lower turnover as tie-breaker. The test period is evaluated only after those choices are frozen.

methodology.ablation: validation-only feature-family comparison with per-family validation alpha tuning
methodology.coefficient_stability: same matured-label expanding Ridge fits used at each prediction month
methodology.bootstrap: non-parametric resampling of monthly Rank IC and top-minus-bottom spread

2C.research_question: Do validation-selected nonlinear tree models add more persistent cross-sectional ranking and portfolio value than the frozen Ridge and conventional baselines?
2C.selection_policy: For each nonlinear model family, feature group and hyperparameters are selected only by 2020-2022 validation mean Rank IC. Portfolio implementation is then selected only by validation Sharpe with lower turnover as tie-breaker. These choices are frozen before evaluating 2023-2025.
2C.test_reuse_disclosure: The 2023-2025 evaluation period was already inspected in Milestones 2A and 2B. Milestone 2C does not tune on it, but it is therefore a frozen historical evaluation period rather than a pristine never-seen holdout.

methodology.target: centered cross-sectional rank of 21-trading-day forward return
methodology.features: centered cross-sectional percentile-rank features from the existing 2A monthly dataset
methodology.walk_forward: expanding monthly training with label_end_date strictly before each signal date
methodology.models: Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM with compact predeclared validation grids
methodology.importance: native tree importance from a reference model fitted immediately before the first test signal
methodology.portfolio: model-specific validation-selected long-only portfolio variant using the 1.2 drift-aware cost engine

3A.research_question: What feature structure and interactions drive the validation-selected nonlinear models, and are those explanations stable across the historical evaluation years?
3A.policy: Milestone 3A is post-hoc explanation only. It does not select features, hyperparameters, portfolio variants, or alter the frozen Milestone 2C models.
3A.reference_model_disclosure: SHAP and permutation diagnostics use one pre-test reference model per selected family, fitted only on labels matured before the first 2023 signal. These explanations characterize the frozen model specification; they are not substitutes for the expanding walk-forward performance results.

3B.research_question: How do frozen linear/nonlinear ranking signals and portfolios behave across market regimes defined only with information available at each signal date?
3B.policy: Milestone 3B is diagnostic only. Regime labels do not select, retune, switch, ensemble, or resize any model or portfolio. The 2023-2025 period is already-inspected historical evidence.

regime_methodology.quantile_levels: VIX, 10Y Treasury and Fed funds low/medium/high use trailing historical tercile thresholds estimated from prior observations only.
regime_methodology.rate_direction: 10Y Treasury 63-trading-day change; flat when within ±0.10 percentage points.
regime_methodology.yield_curve: 10Y-2Y spread: inverted < 0, flat 0 to 0.25 pp, normal above the flat band.
regime_methodology.market_trend: Sign of trailing 63-trading-day compounded Fama-French Mkt-RF.

3B.small_sample_rule: Regime cells with fewer than 6 signal months are flagged and excluded from dispersion summaries.
3B.multiple_comparisons_warning: Many model × regime cells are inspected. Confidence intervals and t-statistics are descriptive, not corrected for multiple testing, and should not be interpreted as discovery p-values.
3B.conditional_portfolio_metric_disclosure: Conditional Sharpe uses non-contiguous monthly-ish holding-period returns tagged by the regime at the signal date. Conditional maximum drawdown is intentionally not reported.

3C.research_question: Can the frozen ML alpha signals be translated into more institutional portfolios by explicitly balancing predicted alpha, covariance risk, position concentration, and turnover?
3C.selection_policy: For each already-frozen alpha model, optimizer risk-aversion/turnover settings are selected only on 2020-2022 validation net Sharpe. Lower turnover breaks exact Sharpe ties. The primary alpha source is also declared using validation only. No 2023-2025 optimizer choice is retuned.
3C.historical_evaluation_disclosure: The 2023-2025 period has been inspected in earlier milestones and remains a frozen historical evaluation period rather than a pristine holdout.

optimizer.covariance: Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage on the trailing 252 trading days, requiring at least 126 observations, using data only through each signal date.
optimizer.alpha: Cross-sectionally standardized frozen model predictions scaled to 10.00% annual alpha per prediction z-score.
optimizer.pretrade_state: Previous target weights are drifted through realized returns to the current signal close before turnover is computed.

3C.constraint_disclosure: If a configured turnover cap is mathematically infeasible because of the initial investment or a position-cap repair, it is relaxed only to the minimum feasible turnover and explicitly flagged in diagnostics.

methodology.historical_data: Frozen pre-2026 Yahoo snapshot is never redownloaded or revised by Milestone 3D.
methodology.incremental_data: Only 2026-onward market data are downloaded into a separate holdout snapshot.
methodology.features: Same stock-specific feature definitions as the frozen historical research pipeline.
methodology.models: Feature families and hyperparameters are loaded from the frozen 2B/2C summaries; no 2026 selection occurs.
methodology.online_retraining: Model parameters are refit monthly using the already-declared expanding matured-label rule; model specifications are unchanged.
methodology.optimizer: Risk/turnover settings are loaded from the frozen 3C summary; no 2026 optimizer selection occurs.
methodology.rank_evaluation: Only 2026 signals with fully observed 21-trading-day forward returns are scored.
methodology.portfolio_evaluation: A 31-Dec-2025 activation signal starts a fresh deployment for Jan-2026; transaction costs include initial investment.
methodology.current_month: The as-of calendar month is excluded from signal generation because it is not yet a completed month.

3D.holdout_integrity_warning: After viewing these 2026 results, changing features, model hyperparameters, portfolio rules, or optimizer settings because of 2026 performance would contaminate this holdout. Future methodology changes require a new prospective period.

frozen_research_rules: Do not change features, model hyperparameters, portfolio rules, optimizer settings or regime definitions because of 2026 results.
Monthly model refitting is allowed only because expanding matured-label retraining was declared before the holdout.
Only 2026 signals with fully matured 21-trading-day labels are eligible for Rank IC.
The as-of date is an exclusive market-data cutoff to avoid incomplete current-session daily bars.
Raw Yahoo data are not intended for redistribution; keep raw parquet files out of the public repository.
